brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel is preparing for a scenario in which the Palestinian Authority directs its weapons toward Israel in the West Bank, according to Maan Wire. He stated that the Israeli military will remain in camps in the northern West Bank and maintain control of the area.

Netanyahu did not specify what triggered his comments or provide a timeframe for the anticipated scenario.

title: Netanyahu prepares for scenario of Palestinian Authority weapons turned against Israel
